```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

data(nyc_airbnb)
```

```{r}
str(nyc_airbnb)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  count(room_type)

nyc_airbnb %>%
  count(neighbourhood_group)
```

Answering Questions
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group =="Manhattan") |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
```

## price
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 3) |> view()
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 2)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(price<1000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=price))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(room_type - neighbourhood_group)
```

prices on average
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price)
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = mean_price
  )
```

## same host stuff

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(calculated_host_listings_count > 10)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=neighbourhood, y = price))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  facet_grid(.~ room_type)+
  theme(axis.test.x = element_text(angle = 90,hjust = 1))
```

## visualize price some more
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = lat, y = long, color = price))+
  geom_point(alpha = .5)
```

make a leaflet map

```{r}
pal = colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis"
)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
 # sample(50) |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addMarkers(~long, ~lat)
```
